args.description: The command and its arguments of a run node (after args_prefix). It is not inherited. Variables can be used.

args_prefix.description: Arguments that are put before args, e.g. ["ssh", "root@{server}"] for all sub-nodes. Inherited from the parent node.

children_on_error.description: The on_error value that the sub-nodes inherit (when they do not specify on_error). When it is not given, the sub-nodes inherit the on_error of the node.

else.patternErrorMessage: expected a status (failed, paused, success) and/or a sibling operation (none, skip, freeze), e.g. paused or "failed, freeze"

collapse_on_finished.description: Collapse the node in the GUI when it finishes. Default: true.

cwd.description: The directory where the processes are started. When it is empty, the current directory of the runner is used (runtree's own for the local runner). Inherited from the parent node.

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file).

def_vars.description: Default variable values: only used when the variable is not inherited from the parent. A variable cannot be in both vars and def_vars.

description.description: Multi-line description of the node, displayed in the GUI when the node is selected.

envs.description: Environment variables (name: value) for the processes of this subtree. Inherited from the parent node.

expand_on_active.description: Expand the node in the GUI when it becomes active. Default: true.

expanded.description: Display the sub-nodes of the node in the GUI when the tree is loaded. Default: false.

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file).

for_vars.description: Repeat the sub-nodes for every combination of the listed variable values (lists of strings, or names of list variables). The first variable changes the slowest.

id.description: Identifier of the node, it must match [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]* and be unique in the tree. A generated id is used when it is not given.

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file).

ifeq.description: Include the node only if all of the given variables have the given values.

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file).

ifneq.description: Include the node only if all of the given variables differ from the given values.

include.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file).

inherit_envs.description: Inherit the environment variables (envs) of the parent node. Default: true.

inherit_vars.description: Inherit the variables of the parent node. def_vars cannot be used when it is false. Default: true.

max_proc.description: Maximum number of running processes in this subtree, -1 means no limit. Inherited from the parent node. Default: -1.

nodes.description: The sub-nodes of a seq or par node.

else.description: a run node, given as a list of arguments

on_error.description: What to do when the process or a sub-node fails: the status of the node (failed, paused or success) and/or an operation on the not yet started siblings (none, skip or freeze). Inherited from the parent's children_on_error, or from its on_error. Inherited from the parent node. Default: failed.

else.patternErrorMessage: expected a status (failed, paused, success) and/or a sibling operation (none, skip, freeze), e.g. paused or "failed, freeze"

par.description: Sub-nodes that run in parallel (this makes the node a par node).

else.description: a run node, given as a list of arguments

provides.description: Names of resources that are provided when the node succeeds. Nodes that require them wait until then. It is not inherited.

requires.description: Names of resources that must be provided (by other nodes) before the node can be started. It is not inherited.

rlocks.description: Names of resources that are locked (reentrant, shared within the subtree) while the node is active. Inherited from the parent node.

runner.description: The runner that runs the processes of the node: local (runtree runs them itself), or the address (host:port or tcp://host:port) of an rtrunner. When it is not set, it is inherited from the parent; the default of the root is local, or the --runner option of runtree. Inherited from the parent node. Default: local.

seq.description: Sub-nodes that run one after the other (this makes the node a seq node).

else.description: a run node, given as a list of arguments

status.description: The initial status of the node. A frozen node is not started until it is thawed manually. Inherited from the parent node. Default: waiting.

success_exit_codes.description: Process exit codes that mean success, e.g. [0, 255] for "ssh host reboot". The listed codes replace the default, so list 0 too if it should also mean success. Inherited from the parent node. Default: [0].

system_envs.description: Use the environment of the runner (runtree's own for the local runner) as a base environment for the processes. Default: true.

title.description: A single line, human-readable title, displayed in the GUI. Variables can be used.

type.description: The type of the node: run (runs a command), seq (runs its sub-nodes one after the other) or par (runs its sub-nodes in parallel). It is not needed when the node has a seq or par property, and a node with include is a seq node by default. Default: run.

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file).

vars.description: Variables (name: value) for this node and its subtree. Values are strings or lists of strings, and can be used as {name} in other properties. Inherited from the parent node.

xlocks.description: Names of resources that are locked exclusively while the node is active. It is not inherited.

description: A runtree file: the tree object, and other top level objects that can be included.

tree.description: The root node of the tree.
